name: Binnacle
author: Joel Cuthriell
description: System instruments for the bar: discovers every sensor, GPU and filesystem present and builds instruments for what it finds, with CPU-by-program accounting that still sees processes after they exit.

barWidget.description: Live CPU/GPU/thermal/memory/network/disk instruments; click for a detail panel.

schema.label: Icon size (px, blank follows the theme)
Dial ceiling for sensors with no critical point (°C)
CPU load
schema.description: Where cpu load appears. "Panel only" keeps it out of the bar strip but in the dropdown.

schema.label: Integrated GPU
schema.description: Where integrated gpu appears. "Panel only" keeps it out of the bar strip but in the dropdown.

schema.label: Discrete GPU
schema.description: Where discrete gpu appears. "Panel only" keeps it out of the bar strip but in the dropdown.

schema.label: Temperatures
schema.description: Where temperatures appears. "Panel only" keeps it out of the bar strip but in the dropdown.

schema.label: Memory
schema.description: Where memory appears. "Panel only" keeps it out of the bar strip but in the dropdown.

schema.label: Network
schema.description: Where network appears. "Panel only" keeps it out of the bar strip but in the dropdown.

schema.label: Filesystems
schema.description: Where filesystems appears. "Panel only" keeps it out of the bar strip but in the dropdown.

schema.label: CPU-by-program leaderboard
schema.description: Ranks what actually used the CPU over the last window, including programs that have since exited.

schema.label: Leaderboard window (seconds)
schema.description: One cgroup sweep per window (~19ms). Longer windows cost less per tick.

schema.label: Temperature unit
schema.description: Unit for every displayed temperature. Dial scales stay physical; only the numbers convert.

schema.label: Bar temperature style
schema.description: How the bar strip shows a temperature: an arc dial, or the reading itself.
